title: Scholarship Program for International Students
summary: Scholarship awarded to foreign nationals coming to Germany to study.

degree_levels.notes: Requires proof of a completed bachelor's degree or completed undergraduate studies if enrolled in a Diplom, Magister, or Staatsexamen program. Master's degree programs are listed under exclusions if referring to specific restrictions, but note text states requirement of completed bachelor's.

subject_areas.notes: Domestic and international students of all disciplines are welcome to apply.

values: state or state-recognized university in Germany
institutions.notes: Must be enrolled or have admission at a state or state-recognized university in Germany.

nationality.notes: Only foreign nationals can apply. EU nationals are also eligible to apply. Must not be eligible for BAföG Section 8.

residence.notes: Must be staying in Germany for the purpose of studying. Must not have been in Germany for more than 15 months at the time of application (unless already studied in Germany or preparing for university).

mandatory.text: Enrollment or at least one admission at a state or state-recognized university in Germany
Proof of a completed bachelor's degree or completed undergraduate studies if enrolled in a Diplom, Magister, or Staatsexamen program
Social or political engagement in the spirit of the Rosa Luxemburg Foundation
Very good German language skills (B2 level)
Not in Germany for more than 15 months at the time of application (with exceptions)
Must be in Germany to study

exceptions.text: A second full-time degree program is not eligible
A part-time program is not eligible
Study abroad in the country of origin or in third countries is not eligible

funding.description: No cash amount stated on the page.

application_rounds.notes: No application deadlines specified on the page.

required_documents.text: Proof of language acquisition (B2 level German)
Proof of a completed bachelor's degree or completed undergraduate studies

sources.title: Study scholarship - Rosa-Luxemburg-Stiftung
sources.notes: In scope because foreign nationals receive funding to physically study in Germany.
